articles.title: Ancient Georgia Pottery Holds Earliest Chocolate Traces East of the Mississippi
articles.summary: Scientists found cacao DNA on 1,000-year-old pottery near Georgia's Etowah mounds — the earliest evidence of chocolate east of the Mississippi. How did it travel so far from the tropics?

articles.title: Wild Sharks Hear Sounds From 243 Feet Away and Know Which Direction They Came From
articles.summary: A new study shows blacktip sharks can detect low-frequency sounds from 243 feet away — and turn away from the source. It's the first proof that free-swimming sharks can locate distant sounds.

articles.title: Jupiter: The Failed Star with a 300-Mile-High Volcano
articles.summary: Jupiter is so massive that 1,300 Earths could fit inside it. It has a centuries-old hurricane, a moon with volcanoes shooting sulfur 300 miles high, and an icy moon that might hide alien life.
